_comment: TITAN CLASS (Steve 2026-10-11). Three titans total, 1-2 per run: the Herald (wave 4, tutorial), one mid wave-5, the Finale (apocalypse). Titans are flagged HERE, not by HP — isTitan() reads this file. They never spawn in the wild pool; they arrive by omen and are faced by coalition only (hard gate).

eater.counter_hint: It can't tell good food from bad. Ask the old ones about the last time something big came hungry.
eater.omen0: Scouts come back pale. Something is eating the fields — not the crops. The FIELD. Furrows gone like soup.
eater.omen1: The traders name it: the Eater. A vast maw the aliens made when they watched us eat and thought it looked like fun.

relic.desc: A tooth like a shovel, still warm. When you eat from the pantry, the first bite of the day is doubled — the Eater's hunger, turned around.
relic.name: The Last Meal

eater.threat: It is eating the realm's food. Every dawn it feeds, a village goes hungry. The coalition musters or the harvest dies.
eater.title: THE HERALD

finale.counter_hint: It ends in three rounds or it ends you. Feed it something you love, or end it first.
finale.omen0: The sky, getting bigger. It starts sky-sized and gets bigger. The old ones stop talking when you ask.
finale.omen1: The System whispers it, for once not delighted: the Finale. Every season needs its climax. This one is yours.

relic.desc: It reads 'PREVIOUSLY ON...' and it's you. Once per run, declare a do-over on a single round — the round replays, everyone forgets except you.
relic.name: The Falling Title Card

finale.threat: It grows every round and once per fight it ends one. The sky is getting bigger. This is the run's apocalypse — everything built was for this.
finale.title: THE FINALE

nielsen.counter_hint: Boring is its armor and its leash. Be unwatchable.
nielsen.omen0: The System's ratings spike at odd hours. Something is performing out there and the numbers are INSANE.
nielsen.omen1: The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

relic.desc: A pocket of the broadcast that never aired. Once per fight, go utterly uninteresting for one round — nothing targets you.
relic.name: Dead Air

nielsen.threat: It feeds on being watched and it is ALWAYS being watched. Every eye on it makes it stronger. The realm must kill it fast, before the audience falls in love.
nielsen.title: THE NIELSEN
